sections.title: AI Services for Los Angeles Healthcare Organizations

items.title: Patient Risk Stratification
items.description: ML models predicting 30-day readmission, clinical deterioration, ED utilization, and chronic disease progression for LA's major health systems — trained on your patient population and calibrated to LA's specific demographic mix and social determinants of health patterns. Cedars-Sinai and UCLA Health both run Epic; ClickMasters designs with Epic FHIR API integration standard. Cost: $55,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 14–22 weeks | Epic FHIR integration standard.
items.label: Risk Stratification

items.title: Digital Health Product AI (LA Startup Ecosystem)
items.description: LA's growing digital health and consumer health startup community — mental health apps, chronic disease management platforms, telehealth tools, and wellness products. ClickMasters builds the AI capabilities at the core of digital health products with HIPAA compliance, FDA SaMD awareness for clinical-facing features, and California CMIA compliance for California-specific deployments. Cost: $40,000–$150,000 | Timeline: 12–28 weeks | HIPAA + CMIA + FDA SaMD.

items.title: Clinical Documentation AI
items.description: NLP reducing physician administrative burden — ambient documentation from clinical conversations, structured note generation, ICD-10 coding assistance, and prior authorization processing. LA's large healthcare organizations face the same documentation burden as other markets but with Spanish-English bilingual requirements for substantial portions of the LA patient population. Cost: $55,000–$135,000 | Timeline: 14–24 weeks | Bilingual English-Spanish available.
items.label: Clinical Documentation

items.title: Revenue Cycle Optimization
items.description: ML claim denial prediction and prevention for LA's complex payer mix — California Medi-Cal (one of the US's largest Medicaid programs), CalPERS, Covered California health plans, and commercial carriers. Denial prediction before submission and coding gap identification typically delivers 8–15% net revenue improvement for LA health systems with adequate historical claim data. Cost: $50,000–$125,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks.
items.label: Revenue Cycle

items.title: Healthcare Operations AI
items.description: Staffing and scheduling optimization, patient flow prediction, supply chain demand forecasting for LA's large multi-facility health systems. LA-specific challenges: extreme traffic patterns affecting staff commutes and transport times, seismic event preparedness in operations AI, and the diversity of patient populations across LA's geographically dispersed facilities. Cost: $50,000–$125,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks.
items.label: Operations AI

sections.title: California Healthcare Compliance Context
sections.description: ClickMasters builds healthcare AI with full awareness of California's regulatory framework.

items.description: The California Medical Information Act imposes requirements stricter than HIPAA in several dimensions — ClickMasters designs LA healthcare AI with both HIPAA and CMIA compliance in mind, and recommends qualified California healthcare counsel for definitive compliance determinations.
items.label: HIPAA + CMIA

items.title: CCPA / CPRA
items.description: For digital health applications using consumer data, CCPA/CPRA compliance is required alongside HIPAA — particularly relevant for LA's consumer-facing health and wellness applications.
items.label: CCPA · CPRA

items.title: Medi-Cal Managed Care
items.description: California's Medi-Cal managed care programs have specific data governance and reporting requirements for AI used in member risk stratification and care management — ClickMasters designs population health AI with Medi-Cal managed care requirements in mind.
items.label: Medi-Cal

items.title: FDA SaMD
items.description: LA's digital health and MedTech community produces AI software that may be regulated as Software as a Medical Device — ClickMasters strongly recommends qualified FDA regulatory counsel for any digital health AI that influences clinical diagnosis or treatment decisions.
items.label: FDA SaMD

sections.note: Definitive regulatory compliance determinations require qualified California healthcare legal and regulatory counsel. ClickMasters provides technical implementation and documentation.
